Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) indicated for chronic kidney disease. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter where mesh_heading equals 'chronic kidney disease'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles (via INNER JOIN compound_structures), efo_id as indication_curie, mesh_heading as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
